release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.1.15

• **Official HD Music Video Playback (720p/1080p)**: Music Video mode now streams YouTube HLS master playlists via iOS InnerTube client, filtered through a loopback HTTP proxy to only serve ≥720p H.264+AAC variants — no more 360p.
• **Strict Official-Only Video Matching**: Two-pass YouTube search with token-based title/artist verification, verified-artist badge checking, and hard rejection of covers, reactions, fan edits, remixes, and topic channels.
• **Audio ↔ Video Handoff**: Switching to Video mode pauses the Rust audio engine and plays the video's own audio; switching back restores playback from the video's last position.
• **Video Not Available Fallback**: Songs without an official music video or lyric video show a clean 'Video not available' card instead of random content.
